h: MultiChoice reportedly takes final decision on cheaper DStv decoder and subscription prices
p: MultiChoice has reportedly settled on lower prices for DStv decoders and subscriptions in Nigeria. Details of the new price list were said to be shared with customers. Subscribers have been waiting for relief as the cost of living bites.
more: The new prices are said to apply to decoders and some bouquets.
Customers are advised to check official channels for the exact figures.
